tips.text: Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port have two rounds of quests; do the pirates and Wastewander bandits together because their camps are next to each other.
Mages: Arcane Explosion AoE on the Wastewander bandit camps is the quickest way through both Wastewander Justice quests.

professionHooks.note: Keep Tender Wolf Meat from Longtooth Runner (Feralas, lvl 40-41) for Tender Wolf Steak. Buy Recipe: Tender Wolf Steak from Dirge Quikcleave (Tanaris 52.6, 28.1) for 1g 20s. Recipe learnable at 225; every craft gives a point until 265 (about 40 crafts). Feralas/Hinterlands/Felwood wolves.

professionHooks.note: Expert First Aid (150-225) and the Mageweave bandage manuals are sold by Balai Lok'Wein at Brackenwall Village. The Horde Triage quest (Doctor Gregory Victor, Hammerfall) unlocks 225-300. Bank your Mageweave and Runecloth for bandages.

tips.text: The Steamwheedle boat to Powderfuse Port is optional travel, about a minute, and it is not tied to Consolation Prize.

professionHooks.note: Jabbey at Steamwheedle Port sells Recipe: Undermine Clam Chowder; it uses the clam meat you have been saving.
